events.title: I SAW THE TV GLOW (2024)
events.description:
Philadelphia Area Horror Meetup Group
Come hang out with us and celebrate Jeremy's birthday as he streams his horror movie bday pick!

**I Saw the TV Glow**
2024 - 1hr 40mins
Horror/Fantasy

In late-90s suburbia, a lonely teenager meets a girl at school who introduces him to a mysterious late-night T.V. show. As time goes on, however, questions begin to arise about why the show sometimes seems more real than their own lives.

**Wicker**
2026 - 1hr 45mins
Comedy/Romance
A fisherwoman lives on the fringes of a seaside village; she is unmarried, stinky, and constantly teased. One day, sick of her stuffy, narrow-minded neighbors, she orders a wicker husband for herself.
